title: Restricted One-Day WOFOST Theory-Code-Architecture Reconciliation
qualification_basis: SWAP 4.3.1 B1.10 source behavior for the admitted actual standard-WOFOST profile; external WOFOST/PCSE lineage is used only as a discrepancy spot-check, not as a replacement oracle

reconciled_findings.finding: legacy assimilation calls ASTRO(daynr,...) internally and therefore couples crop rate physics to calendar/day-number state
reconciled_findings.decision: do not preserve this dependency; DAYL, DAYLP, SINLD, COSLD, DIFPP and DSINBE are explicit forcing/context supplied from outside the provider

reconciled_findings.finding: RAD is read through atmosphere_interface although it is not a formal TOTASS argument
reconciled_findings.decision: RAD becomes an explicit prepare-assimilation input

reconciled_findings.finding: KDIF is read through plant_interface although it is not a formal ASSIM argument
reconciled_findings.decision: KDIF becomes an immutable rate parameter passed explicitly

reconciled_findings.finding: KDIR is parsed from every dynamic crop file but no scoped standard-WOFOST rate equation reads it; direct-beam coefficients are derived from KDIF and solar height
reconciled_findings.decision: exclude KDIR from the restricted production rate-parameter DTO; retain parser compatibility only in an external legacy adapter if needed

reconciled_findings.finding: the seven-day Tmin memory nofd/atmin7 is module-persistent and mutated inside assimilation
reconciled_findings.decision: use the already-qualified F-WOF26 compact optional Tmin continuation; F-WOF27 consumes TMNR read-only and owns no history state

reconciled_findings.finding: legacy parser ranges admit values that later appear as denominators or unsafe exponent bases
examples: DLO==DLC allowed although IDSL=1 divides by DLO-DLC
TSUMEA/TSUMAM==0 allowed although DVR divides by them
KDIF==0 allowed although canopy and critical-LAI equations divide/use inverse KDIF
CFRDM==0 allowed although PGASS divides by CFRDM
CVR/CVS/CVL==0 allowed although CVF divides by them
Q10==0 allowed although Q10 is raised to a potentially negative exponent
reconciled_findings.decision: strengthen semantic provider validation and fail closed before evaluation; this is input-domain qualification, not a physics switch

reconciled_findings.finding: legacy AFGEN stores active knots in fixed alternating x/y arrays and detects a decreasing x as end-of-table sentinel
reconciled_findings.decision: kernel parameter objects store only active strictly increasing knots and preserve clamp/interpolation behavior; sentinel and unused tail remain adapter concerns

reconciled_findings.finding: actual PGASS is always multiplied by RELMF; SW_POTRELMF only selects whether the separate potential shadow also receives RELMF
reconciled_findings.decision: restricted actual provider always applies RELMF and does not expose SW_POTRELMF

reconciled_findings.finding: when SWCROPSNM==1 nutrient factors can further reduce RELTR, alter partitioning, leaf death and SLA
reconciled_findings.decision: the admitted profile excludes that route completely; water-only RELTR is IQROT/IPTRA and nutrient corrections require a separate qualification

reconciled_findings.finding: SWRD=3 can suppress root growth from IALPWET and can replace root death behavior above WRTMAX
reconciled_findings.decision: first provider admits SWRD=1 only; no IALPWET, AERATECRIT, SWWRTNONOX or WRTMAX inputs are present

reconciled_findings.finding: when pre-event LAIEXP>=6 legacy GLAI does not assign r%glaiex, so the structural update reuses the previously stored rate value
reconciled_findings.decision: preserve exact B1.10 behavior through F-WOF26 conditional one-scalar compatibility sidecar; F-WOF27 emits recomputed=false and does not invent a rate

reconciled_findings.finding: daily actual crop rates consume daily integral accumulators IQROT_DAY/IPTRA_DAY after water-process integration; scalar values alone do not prove that they came from the accepted transaction
reconciled_findings.decision: runtime/F-KT owns accepted-window provenance and exactly-once aggregation; the provider receives frozen semantic aggregates and checks only their numerical domain

reconciled_findings.source: wofost.f90::assimilation versus current PCSE WOFOST lineage spot-check
reconciled_findings.finding: the three-point Gauss nodes, weights and HOUR=12+0.5*DAYL*XGAUSS form used by SWAP match the current PCSE WOFOST assimilation implementation; there is no evidence here for a SWAP-specific quadrature defect
reconciled_findings.decision: preserve the SWAP B1.10 quadrature in reference production; do not redesign it in F-WOF27

reconciled_findings.source: SWAP B1.10 assimilation versus current PCSE WOFOST72 lineage
reconciled_findings.finding: SWAP converts DTGA with 30*(0.4/CFRDM)/44 and applies RELMF to actual PGASS, whereas the current PCSE WOFOST72 path uses the canonical 30/44 conversion and has no equivalent SWAP RELMF step in that routine
reconciled_findings.decision: treat CFRDM and RELMF as SWAP-specific admitted physics/extensions and preserve them in reference mode; any removal or normalization is a separate scientific change

source_order_contract.prepare: Tmin history is advanced candidate-locally and actual PGASS is evaluated from the pre-integration state before soil-water substeps
source_order_contract.finalize: DTSUM/DVR and actual dry-matter/organ/leaf rates are evaluated using the same pre-event crop state plus accepted water-window aggregates
source_order_contract.integrate: only F-WOF26 mutates crop owner state after the complete rate packet exists

not_a_claim: scientific equivalence to every modern WOFOST version
admission of nutrients, oxygen, IDSL=2, SWRD=3 or potential shadow
permission to change CFRDM/RELMF behavior in reference mode
